y-m-26-03.title: Chii chinochinja kana tichiziva zvakawanda nezvemadiagonali?
y-m-26-03.goal: Tsanangura, uchibatanidza nemamiriro, kuti kutonga kwokuti kwadhirateri irekitengi kana sikweya kunochinja sei kana ruzivo rwemadiagonali rwuchiwedzerwa rimwe panguva imwe, uye usimbise nemienzaniso yaunogadzira kuti ruzivo rwekutanga oga harwuna kukwana.
y-m-26-03.material: Madiagonali maviri ekwadhirateri ABCD ndi AC ne BD. Rekitengi ikwadhirateri ine makona ayo mana ose akarurama, rombhasi ikwadhirateri ine mativi ayo mana ose akareba zvakafanana, uye sikweya ikwadhirateri ine makona ayo mana ose akarurama nemativi ayo mana ose akareba zvakafanana. Fungidzira kuti watoziva kuti 'kwadhirateri ine madiagonali maviri anoparadzanisana pakati ipararerogiramu'. Makwadhirateri ose anotorwa semakwadhirateri akabuda (makwadhirateri asina chikamu chakadzikira mukati).
y-m-26-03.thinking.0: Kutonga kubva paruzivo rwechikamu uye kugadzirisa kana ruzivo rutsva rwauya
y-m-26-03.prereq.0: Chirevo chepararerogiramu, rekitengi, rombhasi, nesikweya, nehunhu hwemadiagonali avo (nhanho yegiredhi 8)
y-m-26-03.prereq.1: Pakati pemamiriro epararerogiramu, 'madiagonali maviri anoparadzanisana pakati'
y-m-26-03.prereq.2: Chinhambwe pakati pemapoinzi maviri pacoordinate plane
y-m-26-03.s.s1.prompt: Kwadhirateri ABCD, ruzivo rwemadiagonali AC ne BD runoratidzwa rimwe panguva imwe. Nguva dzose, tonga 'kana inogona kutaurwa kuti irekitengi'. (Hapana mufananidzo.)
y-m-26-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nyorazve ruzivo rwega rwega sehunhu 'hwemadiagonali' ekwadhirateri uye uhuenzanise nehunhu hwemadiagonali erekitengi, pararerogiramu, nerombhasi.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.hint.1: Mushure mokuunganidza ruzivo rwose rwakazikanwa kusvikira ikozvino, dhirowa kuti utarise kana kwadhirateri inosangana neruzivo rwose urwu uye isiri rekitengi ichigoneka.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kwadhirateri ABCD inogona kutaurwa kuti irekitengi here?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Pakati pemakwadhirateri ane madiagonali akaenzana pane dzimwe dzisiri marekitengi (semuenzaniso, trapezoid ine mitsipa miviri yakareba zvakafanana). Saka ruzivo urwu oga haruzokuitisi kuti uve nechokwadi kuti irekitengi. Tarisa ruzivo rwunotevera uye ugadzirise kutonga kwako.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Irekitengi. Nokuti rekitengi ine madiagonali akareba zvakafanana
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 'Kana irekitengi, madiagonali akaenzana' ne 'kana madiagonali akaenzana, irekitengi' zvinoenda nenzira dzakasiyana. Kuti kupesana kunoshandawo here kunofanira kuverengwa zvakasiyana.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Haugoni kusimbirira kuti irekitengi. Zvinoratidzika kuti pane makwadhirateri asiri marekitengi kunyange madiagonali akaenzana
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Unogona kudhirowa kwadhirateri ine kureba kwemadiagonali chete kwakaenzana. Kana paine kunyange imwe, haugoni kusimbirira.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hairekitengi. Nokuti hapana chinoti vanoparadzanisana pakati
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ingava rekitengi. 'Hapana chinoti vanoparadzanisana pakati' ne 'havaparadzanisani pakati' zvakasiyana.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ruzivo harwuna kukwana, saka hatigoni kuziva ikozvino. Ingava kana isiri rekitengi
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Ruzivo rutsva: madiagonali maviri anoparadzanisana pakati. (Kana poinzi yokusangana kwemadiagonali iri O, saka AO = CO, BO = DO) Ruzivo rwekutanga (AC = BD) runoramba rwuchiri kuvapo.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kwadhirateri ABCD ikozvino inogona kutaurwa kuti irekitengi here?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana madiagonali achiparadzanisana pakati, ipararerogiramu. Mupararerogiramu ABCD, kuenzanisa katatu ABD nokatatu DCA, AB = DC, AD = DA (yakafanana), BD = CA, saka akaenzana (SSS), uye ∠A = ∠D. Sezvo AB ∥ DC, ∠A + ∠D = 180°, saka ∠A = ∠D = 90°. Saka irekitengi.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Tinogona kungoziva kuti ipararerogiramu uye tichiri kusaziva kana irekitengi
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Zvakarurama kuti ipararerogiramu. Asi unogona kuramba uchishandisa 'AC = BD' yawakaziva pakutanga. Chii chinochinja kana ukashandisa ruzivo rwuviri pamwe chete?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kurhombus unoda ruzivo rwekuti mativi mana akaenzana. Kusvika zvino hapana ruzivo rwehurefu hwemativi.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Irectangle. Iparallelogram ine madiagonal maviri ehurefu hwakafanana, saka makona mana anova akaenzana
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Isquare. Nokuti madiagonal anogovana kuita hafu
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kuti ive square, unoda ruzivo rwekuwedzera rwekuti mativi mana akaenzana. Kugovana kuita hafu kuri kwoga kunokuudza kusvika paparallelogram chete.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Chekupedzisira chakadzidzwa: madiagonal maviri anosangana pamakona akarurama. (AC ⊥ BD)
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kana ukazvisanganisa neruzivo rwose rwekutanga, zita rakadzama zvikuru reABCD ndeipi?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Mu quadrilateral ine madiagonal anogovana kuita hafu, kana madiagonal ari perpendicular, irhombus (mativi mana akaenzana). Yakanga iri rectangle kare, saka makona ose mana akarurama uye mativi ose mana akaenzana, saka isquare. 'Rectangle' yenhanho yapfuura ichiri yakarurama, asi ruzivo rutsva rwakaita kuti zita riite rakajeka zvikuru.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Rhombus hariwo shoko risina kururama (anogovana kuita hafu uye ari perpendicular). Asi kana ukasanganisawo ruzivo rwenhanho yapfuura rwekuti irectangle, kune zita rakadzama zvikuru.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kutaura rectangle hakusi kukanganisa. Asi hauna kushandisa 'perpendicular' yakawanikwa nguva ino. Iparallelogram ine madiagonal ari perpendicular ichii?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakadzidza panhanho yapfuura kuti irectangle. Ruzivo rutsva haruzogoni kuramba mhedziso yekutanga.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.reflect: Fungidzira kuti nei ruzivo rwekutanga (madiagonal ehurefu hwakafanana) rwoga rwusina kukwanisa kukuita wave nechokwadi kuti irectangle, ruzivo rwechipiri rwakawedzera chii, uye kana ruzivo rwekupedzisira rwakachinja kana kuwedzera mhedziso yekutanga.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.prompt: Ngationgororei isu pachedu kuti kana ruzivo rwekutanga chete (AC = BD) rwuzivikanwa, pangangove pasiri rectangle. Isa A(0, 0) ne B(6, 0), uye gadzira ma convex quadrilaterals 2 akasiyana ABCD ane madiagonal AC ne BD ehurefu hwakafanana uye asiri maparallelograms. (Macoordinates epoinzi C ne D)
y-m-26-03.s.s2.hint.0: Gadzika poinzi imwe C uye utsvage kwaungave poinzi D ine daro kubva kuB rakaenzana ne 'daro kubva kuA kuenda kuC'.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.hint.1: Dhirowa quadrilateral nemapoinzi awakasarudza uye uongororewo kana mativi AB ne DC ari parallel uye kana mativi AD ne BC ari parallel.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.ok.c1: C ne D zviri pamusoro pedivi AB.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ma y-coordinate eC neD anofanira kuva makuru kupfuura 0 (pamusoro peAB).
y-m-26-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Iconvex quadrilateral inobatanidza A, B, C, D nenzira.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Kana ukabatanidza A, B, C, D nenzira, iquadrilateral ine concave kana inopindirana pachayo. Sarudza mapoinzi zvakare kuti ive quadrilateral ine makona mana ose ari pasi pe180°.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Hurefu hweAC neBD hahuenzani. Verenga hurefu hwemadiagonal maviri wega uye uvaenzanise.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Quadrilateral iyi iparallelogram (kusanganisira rectangle). Gadzira muenzaniso usiri parallelogram.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana C(5, 3) ne D(1, 3), AC² = 34 ne BD² = 25 + 9 = 34 (trapezoid ine mativi maviri ehurefu hwakafanana). Kana C(4, 3) ne D(3, 4), AC = BD = 5 asi hapana mativi maviri ari parallel. Zvose zvine madiagonal akaenzana asi hazvisi marectangle. Saka haugoni kuva nechokwadi kubva pahurefu hwemadiagonal chete.

y-m-26-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Huwandu ndi nhamba dzakazara dzine 0 kana kupfuura.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Huwandu hunofanira kuva nhamba dzakazara dzine 0 kana kupfuura.
y-m-26-06.title: Tingazadza sei nzvimbo yakatenderedza poinzi nekusanganisa mapolygon akaenzana?
y-m-26-06.topic: Makona emukati emapolygon akaenzana nemakona akatenderedza poinzi
y-m-26-06.goal: Batanidza kona imwe yemukati yepolygon yakaenzana ne360° yemakona akatenderedza poinzi kuwana nzira dzakawanda dzinokodzera mamiriro, uye utsanangure kuti ungadzivana sei nekusiya chero, uye kuti mamiriro aya anokurukura vertex imwe chete.
y-m-26-06.material: Chitoro chemateyera chinoda kushandisa matayera eequilateral triangle, square, neregular hexagon. Matayera ose ane hurefu hwedivi hwakafanana, saka anogona kubatanidzwa chaizvo divi nedivi. Mumushando uyu, unoshanda chete kuti kana matayera akawanda akaunganidzwa pavertex imwe, makona akatenderedza poinzi iyoyo anoita 360° chaizvo pasina nzvimbo dzisina chinhu kana kupindirana. Kana izvi zvichigona kufukidza plane yose hazvibatwi.
y-m-26-06.thinking.1: Kugadzira nzira yakarongeka yekuwana usina kusiya
y-m-26-06.prereq.0: Huwandu hwemakona emukati epolygon nekona imwe yemukati yeregular n-gon (ukuru hwegiredhi 8)
y-m-26-06.prereq.1: Makona akatenderedza poinzi ane huwandu hwe360°
y-m-26-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mapolygon ose akaenzana umo makopi akawanda erudzi rumwe chete rwoga anogona kuzadza chaizvo nzvimbo yakatenderedza poinzi pasina nzvimbo dzisina chinhu kana kupindirana. (Kona imwe yemukati yeregular n-gon i180° × (n − 2) ÷ n.)
y-m-26-06.s.s1.hint.0: Wana kona imwe yemukati yeregular polygon imwe neimwe neformula uye uinyore mutebhura.
y-m-26-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ongorora kuti kona imwe neimwe yemukati inofanira kuwedzerwa kangani kuti iite 360° chaizvo, uye uone kana pane remainder.
y-m-26-06.s.s1.r.a: Kona imwe yemukati i135°; ongorora kuti chii chinoitika kana ukagovanisa 360° ne135°.
y-m-26-06.s.s1.r.d: Kona imwe yemukati i108°; ongorora kana 360° ichigovanika ne108°.
y-m-26-06.s.s1.explain: Makona akatenderedza poinzi ari 360°. Kana kona imwe yemukati i60°, 90°, kana 120°, 6, 4, kana 3 chaizvo dzinoizadza. 108° ne135° hazvigovanise 360° zvakaenzana. Nzvimbo dzisina chinhu dzinoonekwa kana kupindirana.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino unogona kusanganisa maequilateral triangles, masquare, nemaregular hexagons. Gadzira nzira 3 dzakasiyana dzakasanganiswa dzinozadza chaizvo nzvimbo yakatenderedza poinzi pasina nzvimbo dzisina chinhu kana kupindirana, uchishandisa marudzi maviri kana kupfuura pakati pemasquare, maequilateral triangles, nemaregular hexagons. (Nhamba yechimiro chimwe nechimwe)
y-m-26-06.s.s2.hint.0: Edza nhamba dzechimiro chimwe nechimwe dzine makona emukati anowedzera kusvika ku360°. Zvakanaka kutanga wasarudza nhamba yerudzi rumwe.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga huwandu uchishandisa nhamba dzawakasarudza; kana huri pasi pe360°, wedzera michimiro, uye kana huri pamusoro, chinja michimiro.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Huwandu hwemakona hauzi 360°. Wedzera 60° kuequilateral triangle, 90° kusquare, uye 120° kuregular hexagon kakawanda sehuwandu hwechimwe nechimwe.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Uyu musanganiswa une rudzi rumwe chete. Sanganisa marudzi maviri kana kupfuura.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.explain: Nzira dzemaintegers dzakasanganiswa dzinozadza chaizvo nzvimbo yakatenderedza poinzi dzine maviri kana kupfuura eequilateral triangles, masquare, neregular hexagons ndedzi ina chete (equilateral triangles, squares, regular hexagons) = (3, 2, 0), (1, 2, 1), (4, 0, 1), (2, 0, 2). Zvisinei, huwandu hwe360° papoinzi imwe mamiriro anodiwa chete, uye kuti nzira iyi inogona kufukidza plane yose here zvinoda kuongororwawo kumamwe mavertices.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Unofanira kutsvaga sei kuti uve nechokwadi chekuti 'wawana zvose' musanganiswa yakadaro? Nyora nzira yauchashandisa.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rongedza musanganiswa yawakawana kusvika zvino mutebhura uye utarise kuti wakaiwana nekutevedzana kupi.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Edza nzira yekugadzika nhamba yeregular hexagons, sa0 ne1, uye kuzadza kona yakasara.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Tanga wasarudza huwandu hwe ... ne ...
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Kurongeka kwacho kwakajeka here, apo unosarudza huwandu hwechimiro chimwe uye woverenga zvimwe zvasara?
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora kuti ungaziva sei kuti hapana zvimwe kana ukaita saizvozvo here?
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana ukaisa huwandu hwema regular hexagons nenhevedzano se 0, 1, 2, 3 uye ukaverenga rimwe nerimwe kana angle yasara ichigona kuzadzwa nema equilateral triangles e 60° nema squares e 90°, unogona kuwana zvose pasina kusiya. Huwandu i 360°, saka haigone kuva ne regular hexagons dzinopfuura 3.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana ukaparadzanisa huwandu hwe 360° kuita mayuniti e 30°, equilateral triangle i mayuniti 2, square i mayuniti 3, uye regular hexagon i mayuniti 4, saka (huwandu hwema equilateral triangles)×2+(huwandu hwema squares)×3+(huwandu hwema regular hexagons)×4=12. Kana ukaita tebhura uye ukaisa nhamba imwe neimwe, unogona kutarisa zviitiko zvese.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.model.2: Gadzirisa huwandu hwema regular hexagons rimwe panguva se 0, 1, 2, 3, uye nenhevedzano uverenge kana angle yasara ichigona kuzadzwa nema regular triangles nema squares, uye urongedze zviitiko zvese mutebhura.

y-m-26-01.title: Kana uchiziva mativi maviri nekona imwe, katatu rinosarudzwa kuva rimwe here?
y-m-26-01.topic: Mamiriro okufanana kwemakatatu (mativi maviri nekona imwe)
y-m-26-01.goal: Ratidza nokugadzira mienzaniso inopikisa iwe pachako kuti chirevo chokuti 'mativi maviri nekona imwe zvakaenzana' hachigoni kushanda zvichienderana nokuti kona iri kupi, uye utonge kuti chii chimwe chinodikanwa kuti uve nechokwadi kuti makatatu akaenzana.
y-m-26-01.material:
Jihu akati, "Mukatatu ABC nokatatu DEF, kana AC=DF=10cm, BC=EF=6.5cm, uye ∠A=∠D, saka makatatu maviri akaenzana!"

Kuti tikwanise kuriyedza, ndakaisa katatu ABC pacoordinate plane (bhokisi rimwe ndi 1cm). A ndiyo origin (0, 0) uye C ndi (8, 6). Saka AC=10cm. B ipoinzi iri paaxis ye x, kurudyi kwa A (x-coordinate yayo iri pamusoro). ∠A ndiyo kona inogadzirwa nechikamu AB paaxis ye x nechikamu AC. Tinogona kuisa katatu DEF nenzira imwe chete kuti AC=DF uye ∠A=∠D. Ikozvino tsvaga poinzi B ine BC=6.5cm.
y-m-26-01.thinking.2: Kutonga kana ruzivo rwakakwana nokutsvaga zvimwe zvinodikanwa
y-m-26-01.prereq.0: Kudzidza mamiriro okufanana kwemakatatu SSS, SAS, ASA (nhanho yegiredhi 8)
y-m-26-01.prereq.1: Nzvimbo dzemapoinzi pacoordinate plane nechinhambwe pakati pemapoinzi maviri
y-m-26-01.prereq.2: Hukama pakati pemativi matatu ekatatu rine kona yakarurama (inobatsira kana uchitarisa kureba)
y-m-26-01.s.s1.prompt: Unofungei nezvechirevo chaJihu? Sarudza kutonga kunonzwisisika zvikuru parizvino.
y-m-26-01.s.s1.hint.0: Mumamiriro aJihu, nyora mazita emativi maviri ane kureba kwakapiwa nemazita emativi maviri anogadzira ∠A.
y-m-26-01.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa mitsara miviri uye utarise kana ∠A iri pakati pemativi maviri akapiwa.
y-m-26-01.s.s1.o.a: Dzakaenzana. Mativi maviri nekona imwe zvakaenzana, saka zvinowira pamamiriro okufanana SAS
y-m-26-01.s.s1.r.a: SAS inoshandiswa chete kana makona ari pakati pemativi maviri akaenzana. Mudambudziko iri, ∠A ikona iri pakati pemativi mapi maviri pa AC ne BC?
y-m-26-01.s.s1.o.b: Zvingasiyana zvichienderana nokuti kona iri kupi. Dhirowa kuti uone kana paine katatu rimwe
y-m-26-01.s.s1.r.b: Iyi ndiyo maitiro anofungawo nezvenzvimbo yekona uye anoedza kutarisa kutonga nomuedzo.
y-m-26-01.s.s1.o.c: Hadzifanani. Mativi maviri nekona imwe haangasarudzi katatu
y-m-26-01.s.s1.r.c: Idambudziko rokuparadzanisa ne 'hazvigoni'. Kana mativi maviri nekona iri pakati pawo zvapiwa, katatu rinosarudzwa (SAS). Funga kuti kona iri kupi.
y-m-26-01.s.s1.o.d: Ndisati ndaona mufananidzo, handigoni kutaura chinhu pamusoro pokuti dzakaenzana kana kwete
y-m-26-01.s.s1.r.d: Mamiriro apiwa senhamba, saka unogona kuaedza kunyange pasina mufananidzo. Gadzira iwe pachako nemacoordinate kana sketch.
y-m-26-01.s.s1.explain: Jihu akapfupisa mamiriro kuva 'mativi maviri nekona imwe'. Mudambudziko iri, ∠A haisi kona iri pakati pemativi maviri akapiwa AC ne BC. Mhedzisiro inogona kusiyana zvichienderana nokuti kona iri kupi, saka ngatiyedzei iwe pachako muchikamu chinotevera.
y-m-26-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira makatatu ABC 2 akasiyana anosangana nemamiriro ose aJihu. Unongoda kusarudza x-coordinate bx yepoinzi B. (B iri paaxis ye x.)
y-m-26-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ngatiti poinzi B ndi (b, 0), uye unyore nemashoko mamiriro ari pa b kuti chinhambwe kuenda ku C(8, 6) chive 6.5.
y-m-26-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga kuti B inofanira kuva kure sei zvakarara kubva papoinzi (8, 0), apo mutsetse wakananga kubva ku C unosangana neaxis ye x, uye utarise kuruboshwe nokurudyi kwepoinzi iyoyo.
y-m-26-01.s.s2.ok.c1: B iri paaxis ye x kurudyi kwa A.
y-m-26-01.s.s2.fail.c1: B inofanira kuva kurudyi kwa A(0, 0), ndiko kuti, poinzi iri paaxis ye x ine x-coordinate yakakura kupfuura 0.
y-m-26-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Kureba kwa BC hakusi 6.5cm. Tarisazve chinhambwe pakati pepoinzi B ne C(8, 6).
y-m-26-01.s.s2.explain: Kana B=(5.5, 0), saka AB=5.5cm, uye kana B=(10.5, 0), saka AB=10.5cm. Mumakatatu ose maviri AC=10cm, BC=6.5cm, uye ∠A yakafananawo, asi AB inosiyana saka hadzienzani. Chirevo chaJihu chine muenzaniso unopikisa, nyaya iyi, apo chisingashande.
y-m-26-01.s.s3.prompt: Ikozvino unoda kuparadzanisa kana makatatu maviri akaenzana. Zvatozikanwa ndi AC=DF=10cm, BC=EF=6.5cm, ∠A=∠D. Sarudza sarudzo dzose, kana chimwe chete chezvinotevera chikaziviswa pamusoro pezvi, dzinokuita kuti uve nechokwadi kuti makatatu akaenzana.
y-m-26-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kumakatatu maviri awakagadzira pamusoro (AB=5.5 ne AB=10.5), verenga kuti kukosha kuri musarudzo kwakasiyana here kana kwakafanana.
y-m-26-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kana kukosha kuri musarudzo kuchibuda kwakafanana mumakatatu ose maviri, ruzivo urwu haruvaparadzanisi. Tsvaga kukosha kunobuda kwakasiyana.
y-m-26-01.s.s3.o.a: Kureba kwomutsetse wakananga kubva ku C kuenda ku AB (kana kutambanudzwa kwawo) ndi 6cm mumakatatu ose maviri
y-m-26-01.s.s3.r.a: Kukosha uku kwatogadziriswa na AC=10 ne ∠A oga. Hairuzivo rutsva, saka haigoni kuparadzanisa nyaya mbiri.
y-m-26-01.s.s3.o.b: Kureba kwa AB ne DE kwakaenzana
y-m-26-01.s.s3.r.c: 'Haisi kona yakarurama' inoshanda munyaya mbiri dzose. Haigoni kuva ruzivo runoparadzanisa nyaya mbiri.
y-m-26-01.s.s3.explain: Kana AB yakafanana, mativi ose matatu akafanana (SSS). Kana maperimita akaenzana, kubvisa AC ne BC zvatoenzana kunosiya AB yakaenzana. ∠C ikona iri pakati pa AC ne BC, saka mativi maviri nekona iri pakati pawo zvinoenzana (SAS). Kune rimwe divi, kureba kwomutsetse wakananga 6cm kana 'haisi kona yakarurama' zvatoshanda kumakatatu ose maviri, saka haagoni kuaparadzanisa.

y-m-26-04.title: Tinoda kuziva chii kuti tiwane upamhi hwedziva?
y-m-26-04.topic: Segment inobatanidza pakati pemativi maviri etriangle
y-m-26-04.goal: Siyanisa nechidimbu cheruzivo mamiriro umo midpoint theorem inoshanda, tsanangura nekugadzira nyaya kuti nei parallelism yoga isingagoni kusarudza hurefu, uye usarudze maitiro ekubata musiyano pakati pekukosha kwetheory nekwakayerwa.
y-m-26-04.material: Pane mapoinzi B ne C pamucheto wedziva, saka BC haigoni kuyerwa zvakananga. Poinzi A yakasarudzwa kunze kwedziva, rwodzi rwakadhonzwa rwakasimba, poinzi M yakaiswa pasegment AB uye poinzi N pasegment AC, uye MN chete ndiyo yakayerwa ndokubuda 30m. Mapoinzi ose ari pasi rakati sandara rimwe chete. Vadzidzi vakataura kuti 'BC = 60m'. Munhanho mbiri dzekutanga, fungidzira kuti hapana kukanganisa kwekuyera mutepi yekuyera.
y-m-26-04.thinking.1: Kugadzira nyaya yecounterexample kana mamiriro mashoma chete aripo
y-m-26-04.thinking.2: Kududzira musiyano pakati pekukosha kwetheory nekwakayerwa
y-m-26-04.prereq.0: Hunhu hwesegment inobatanidza pakati pemativi maviri etriangle (ukuru hwegiredhi 8)
y-m-26-04.prereq.2: Maratio ehurefu hwemasegment nemitsetse yakafanana (inobatsira kunzwisisa)
y-m-26-04.s.s1.prompt: B ne C ndiwo migumo miviri yedziva, saka BC haigoni kuyerwa zvakananga. Poinzi M iri paAB, poinzi N iri paAC, uye MN = 30m. Vadzidzi vakataura kuti 'BC = 60m'. Pamusoro pezvi, kana chimwe nechimwe chezvidimbu zveruzivo zvinotevera chikawedzerwa 'chimwe panguva', sarudza zvose zvaunogona kuva nechokwadi nazvo kuti BC = 60m.
y-m-26-04.s.s1.hint.0: Pasarudzo yega yega, nyora mumutsara mumwe kana nzvimbo dzeM paAB neN paAC dzakasarudzwa.
y-m-26-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kusarudzo umo nzvimbo yeM kana N isina kusarudzwa, fungidzira kana ratio yeBC kuMN ingachinja kana ukafambisa poinzi iyoyo.
y-m-26-04.s.s1.r.a: Kana ari parallel uye AM = AN, zvose zvaunogona kuziva ndezvekuti AB = AC. Kana usingazive kuti M iri papi paAB, haugoni kuziva kuti MN inoita nguva dzingani BC.
y-m-26-04.s.s1.o.b: M ipakati peAB, uye N ipakati peAC
y-m-26-04.s.s1.o.c: M ipakati peAB, uye AM = AN
y-m-26-04.s.s1.r.c: Kunyange kana M iri pakati, haugoni kuziva kana N iri pakati peAC. Nokuti AB neAC zvinogona kusiyana.
y-m-26-04.s.s1.r.d: Kana ari parallel chete, segment parallel inobuda chero kwaunoisa M. Ratio yehurefu inochinja zvichienderana nenzvimbo yeM.
y-m-26-04.s.s1.o.e: M ipakati peAB, uye MN ∥ BC
y-m-26-04.s.s1.explain: Segment inobatanidza pakati pemativi maviri iparallel nedivi rakasara uye ihafu yehurefu hwaro. Zvakare, 'mutsetse unopfuura nepakati pedivi rimwe uye parallel nedivi rimwe' unopfuurawo nepakati pedivi rakasara. Saka b ne e zvinovimbisa BC = 2 × MN = 60m. Kune zvimwe, nzvimbo yeM (kana yeN) haina kusarudzwa, saka BC ingasava 60m.
y-m-26-04.s.s2.prompt: Fungidzira nyaya umo unoziva sarudzo d chete (MN ∥ BC). Gadzira nyaya umo BC isiri 60m, nyora hurefu hweBC senhamba, uye utsanangure kuti nei inobuda zvakadaro.
y-m-26-04.s.s2.hint.0: Chengeta MN ∥ BC sezvakaita uye ufungidzire kuti chii chinoitika kuratio yehurefu hwesegment MN neBC kana ukafambisa poinzi M paAB kuenda kuA kana kuB.
y-m-26-04.s.s2.hint.1: Gadzika M imwe, nyora AM : AB zvakananga, uye uverenge BC kubva paratio iyoyo ne MN = 30m.
y-m-26-04.s.s2.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana M iri pa... yeAB, saka ...
y-m-26-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Hurefu hweBC hwawakanyora hwakaverengwa zvakarurama kubva panzvimbo yeM (AM : AB) ne MN = 30m here?
y-m-26-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora kuti 'kana ari parallel chete, M inogona kuva kupi zvako' here?
y-m-26-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakaienzanisa nechokwadi chekuti inova 60m kana M ichiva pakati here?
y-m-26-04.s.s2.model.0: Kunyange kana MN ∥ BC, zvinoenderana nenzvimbo yeM. Semuenzaniso, kana AM iri chikamu chimwe chetatu cheAB, similarity ratio i1 : 3, saka BC i3 times MN, ndiko kuti, 90m. Inova 60m chete kana M iri pakati, saka haugoni kutaura 60m kubva paparallelism yoga.
y-m-26-04.s.s2.model.1: Kunyange kana M isiri pakati peAB asi poinzi iri padhuze neB, unogona kuidhirowa neMN ∥ BC. Kana AM : AB i3 : 4, saka MN : BC i3 : 4 futi, saka BC i40m. Saka haugoni kuva nechokwadi kuti i60m kubva paruzivo rweparallelism chete.
y-m-26-04.s.s3.prompt: Mushure mekusimbisa ruzivo b (M neN imwe neimwe ipakati), wakayera BC netepi yekuyera ukawana 58m (MN i30m). Sarudza zvose maitiro akakodzera ekubata mugumisiro uyu.
y-m-26-04.s.s3.hint.0: Fungidzira kuti musiyano pakati pekukosha kwetheory nekwakayerwa uri mangani muzana ekukosha kwetheory.
y-m-26-04.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora mamiriro ose anofanira kuchengetwa kuti theorem ishande (nzvimbo dzemapoinzi, hurefu) uye ufunge kuti kukanganisa kunogona kubuda papi pasite.
y-m-26-04.s.s3.o.a: Ongorora zvakare maka epakati uye uyere MN neBC kamwe zvakare
y-m-26-04.s.s3.o.b: Pedzisa kuti midpoint theorem haishande pasi chairo
y-m-26-04.s.s3.r.b: Theorem inotaura nezvekana mapoinzi ari pakati chaipo uye hurefu hwakaenzana chaizvo. Muchokwadi, kukanganisa kunoitika mumaka epakati nemutepi yekuyera.
y-m-26-04.s.s3.o.c: Tora 58m sekusina kururama uye ushandise kukosha kwetheory 60m semhinduro chaiyo
y-m-26-04.s.s3.r.c: Kana ukafuratira kukosha kwakayerwa ukavimba kukosha kwetheory chete, unoshaya mukana wekuti maka epakati kana mamiriro epasi akanga asina kururama. Unofanira kutanga waongorora musiyano wekukosha kuviri.
y-m-26-04.s.s3.o.d: Shandisa kuti musiyano we2m uri mukati meunogona kubva panzvimbo dzepakati kana kukanganisa kwetepi yekuyera
y-m-26-04.s.s3.o.e: Nyora zvakare MN se29m kuti BC ive 58m uye upedzise nenzira iyoyo
y-m-26-04.s.s3.r.e: Hauna kufanira kuchinja kukosha kuti kuenderane. Wakachinja nhamba usina kuongorora kuti kukosha kupi kwaiva nekukanganisa.
y-m-26-04.s.s3.explain: Musiyano we2m pakati pekukosha kwetheory 60m nekwakayerwa 58m unopfuura 3% zvishoma. Maka epakati angangova akanga asina kururama zvishoma, rwodzi rwaigona kunge rwusina kusimba, kana pasi paigona kunge pasiri sandara. Maitiro akakodzera ndeekuyera zvakare uye kushanda huwandu hwekukanganisa. Hauna kufanira kuchinja kukosha kwakayerwa kana kwetheory pasina chikonzero.

y-m-26-07.title: Circumcenter i mukati metriangle nguva dzose here?
y-m-26-07.goal: Ongorora 'circumcenter i mukati metriangle nguva dzose' nedata rakabva mutebhura, ita fungidziro yetriangle itsva, uye wobva wataura nzvimbo ye circumcenter nerudzi rwetriangle, nemamiriro.
y-m-26-07.material:
Circumcenter yetriangle i poinzi iri padhuri rakafanana kubva kuma vertices matatu. Ara akati, 'Circumcenter yetriangle inogara iri mukati metriangle.' Pazasi pane mhedzisiro yekuongorora ma triangle 5 pa coordinate plane. (Sikweya imwe ye coordinates = 1cm. Ma coordinates e circumcenter i mitengo yakawanikwa nekuverenga.)

No. | Ma vertices A, B, C | Angle hombe zvikuru | Ma coordinates e circumcenter | Nzvimbo ye circumcenter
1 | (0,0), (6,0), (3,4) | anenge 74° | (3, 0.875) | mukati metriangle
2 | (0,0), (8,0), (0,6) | 90° | (4, 3) | pa divi BC (pakati pe BC)
3 | (0,0), (10,0), (5,2) | anenge 136° | (5, −5.25) | kunze kwetriangle
4 | (0,0), (7,0), (2,5) | anenge 68° | (3.5, 1.5) | mukati metriangle
5 | (0,0), (5,0), (−1,2) | anenge 117° | (2.5, 2.5) | kunze kwetriangle
y-m-26-07.thinking.2: Kuita fungidziro kubva mutebhura nekucherechedza miganhu yegeneralization
y-m-26-07.prereq.0: Zvinoreva circumcenter yetriangle (poinzi iri padhuri rakafanana kubva kuma vertices matatu)
y-m-26-07.prereq.1: Zvinoreva acute, right, ne obtuse triangles
y-m-26-07.prereq.2: Kuverenga nzvimbo yemapoinzi pa coordinate plane
y-m-26-07.s.s1.prompt: Ara akati, 'Circumcenter yetriangle inogara iri mukati metriangle.' Sarudza zvese zvinogona kuverengwa kubva mutebhura riri pamusoro oga.
y-m-26-07.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga tebhura mutsetse nemutsetse uye umakire kana circumcenter iri mukati, padivi, kana kunze.
y-m-26-07.s.s1.hint.1: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, nyora kuti yakavakirwa pamitsetse ipi, uye utarise kuti zvechokwadi zvinobuda saizvozvo pamitsetse iyoyo.
y-m-26-07.s.s1.o.a: Mumitsetse 1 ne 4 yetebhura, circumcenter i mukati metriangle
y-m-26-07.s.s1.o.b: Pakati pema triangles ari mutebhura, rimwe chete rine circumcenter kunze kwetriangle
y-m-26-07.s.s1.r.b: Verenga kuti nhamba dzipi mutebhura i ma triangle ane circumcenter kunze.
y-m-26-07.s.s1.o.c: Ndasimbisa kuti circumcenter inogara iri padivi refu zvikuru
y-m-26-07.s.s1.r.c: Ma triangles mangani mutebhura ane circumcenter padivi refu zvikuru? Muenzaniso mumwe unokubvumira kutaura 'nguva dzose' here?
y-m-26-07.s.s1.o.d: Mutsetse 3 wetebhura i muenzaniso usingaenderani nechirevo chaAra
y-m-26-07.s.s1.o.e: Kutarisa tebhura oga, chirevo chaAra chinobuda chakarurama
y-m-26-07.s.s1.r.e: Tarisa, pamutsetse mumwe nemumwe wetebhura, kana circumcenter i mukati.
y-m-26-07.s.s1.o.f: Tebhura rine zviitiko apo circumcenter i mukati metriangle, padivi, uye kunze
y-m-26-07.s.s1.explain: Mutebhura, mitsetse 1 ne 4 i mukati, mutsetse 2 i padivi (pakati pe hypotenuse), uye mitsetse 3 ne 5 i kunze. Saka mienzaniso sa mitsetse 3 ne 5 haienderani ne 'nguva dzose mukati'. Mienzaniso 1 kana 2 haigone kuratidza 'nguva dzose', asi counterexample imwe inogona kuputsa 'nguva dzose'.
y-m-26-07.s.s2.prompt: Kune triangle itsva isiri mutebhura. Ma vertices ayo i A(0, 0), B(9, 0), C(4, 2). Usati wawana ma coordinates e circumcenter, uchaitei nezve nzvimbo ye circumcenter?
y-m-26-07.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga waenzanisa zvimiro zvema triangles ari mutebhura ane circumcenter kunze (angle yavo hombe zvikuru yakadini).
y-m-26-07.s.s2.hint.1: Dhirowa kuti vertex yetriangle itsva inogona kuva ne angle hombe zvikuru iri kupi, uye ufungidzire kana i hombe kupfuura 90°.
y-m-26-07.s.s2.o.a: Ndinofungidzira kuti i mukati metriangle. 2 pa 5 mutebhura vaiva saizvozvo, saka inogona
y-m-26-07.s.s2.r.a: 2 chete pa 5 vaiva mukati. Izvozvo zvakaenderana nechimiro pama vertices; wakatarisa kuti triangle iyi ine chimiro chipi here?
y-m-26-07.s.s2.o.b: Ndinofungidzira kuti i padivi AB. Nekuti circumcenter i padivi refu zvikuru
y-m-26-07.s.s2.r.b: Chii chaiva chakasiyana nema triangles mutebhura ane circumcenter padivi? Tarisa kana triangle iyi ine chimiro ichocho.
y-m-26-07.s.s2.o.c: Zvinoratidzika kuti i kunze. Nekuti inoratidzika kuva ne angle hombe, sa mitsetse 3 ne 5 yetebhura
y-m-26-07.s.s2.o.d: Handizivi kusvikira ndaverenga, uye ndichawana ma coordinates e circumcenter ndotarisa
y-m-26-07.s.s2.r.d: Iyi i maitiro ekunonotsa fungidziro uye kutarisa zvakananga. Kana ukatanga wafungidzira kubva padata retebhura, uchaziva kuti unofanira kutarisa chii kana uchitarisa.
y-m-26-07.s.s2.explain: C(4, 2) yakamakwa pasi pamusoro pepakati pe A ne B, saka ∠C i obtuse (anenge 132°). Ine chimiro chakafanana nemutsetse 3 wetebhura (obtuse triangle). Muchokwadi circumcenter i (4.5, −4), kunze kwetriangle (pasi pe AB). Zvakanaka kungofungidzira usingaverengi, uye kutarisa nekuverenga kwakanakawo.
y-m-26-07.s.s2.acc.0: Kunonotsa fungidziro uye kuverenga zvakananga kunewo musoro. Asi kuita fungidziro kubva padata retebhura wobva wotarisa nekuverenga i tsika iri nani.
y-m-26-07.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvakare chirevo chaAra. Uchishandisa data retebhura sehumbowo, nyora kuti circumcenter i mukati, padivi, kana kunze kwema triangles api, uye kana pane chikamu chisati charatidzwa, taura izvozvo zvakare.
y-m-26-07.s.s3.hint.0: Pamutsetse mumwe nemumwe wetebhura, nyora rudzi rwetriangle (acute/right/obtuse) nenzvimbo ye circumcenter padivi pedivi.
y-m-26-07.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa kana, kana ukaparadzanisa ma triangles erudzi rumwechete, nzvimbo ye circumcenter ine chimwe chinhu chakafanana.

y-m-26-07.s.s3.model.0: Zvinoratidzika kuti kana ma angles ese matatu i acute, circumcenter i mukati; kana i right triangle, i pa hypotenuse; uye kana i obtuse triangle, i kunze. Ma triangles 5 mutebhura vese vaiva saizvozvo, asi ndakatarisa 5 chete, saka handisati ndaratidza.
y-m-26-07.s.s3.model.1: 'Nguva dzose mukati' yakaipa. Ma triangles ane obtuse angle, sa mitsetse 3 ne 5 yetebhura, aiva ne circumcenter kunze, uye right triangle yaiva nayo padivi. Ndinoda kuverenga mamwe ma triangles matsva akati wandei kuti nditarise.

y-m-26-02.title: Dambudziko riri papi mumbiri iyi?
y-m-26-02.topic: Hunhu hwemakatatu ane mativi maviri akaenzana nezvikanganiso mumbiri
y-m-26-02.goal: Tsvaga kukanganisa kwokushandisa mhedziso inofanira kuratidzwa sehumbowo mumbiri, uye utonge kuti inogona kugadziriswa nenzira dzakasiyana kuti mamiriro okufanana ashande zvakarurama.
y-m-26-02.material: Seohyeon anoda kuratidza 'Mukatatu ABC, kana AB = AC, saka ∠B = ∠C'. AB = AC ndiyo pfungwa yokutanga uye ∠B = ∠C ndiyo mhedziso inofanira kuratidzwa. Pazasi pane mbiri yakanyorwa naSeohyeon. Iverenge uchiparadzanisa pfungwa yokutanga nomhedziso. Poinzi M ipoinzi iri padivi BC. (Hapana mufananidzo. Fungidzira katatu ABC rine chikamu chakadhirowa kubva papamusoro A kuenda padivi BC.)
y-m-26-02.thinking.0: Kuparadzanisa mitsetse yembiri kuva pfungwa yokutanga/mhedziso kuti utsvage kukanganisa
y-m-26-02.thinking.1: Kuenzanisa nzira dzakati wandei dzakarurama dzokugadzirisa
y-m-26-02.prereq.0: Chirevo chekatatu rine mativi maviri akaenzana (katatu rine mativi maviri ane kureba kwakaenzana)
y-m-26-02.prereq.1: Mamiriro okufanana kwemakatatu SSS, SAS, uye mamiriro okufanana kwekatatu rine kona yakarurama RHS
y-m-26-02.s.s1.prompt: Seohyeon akanyora zvinotevera, achiti anoratidza 'makona maviri epasi ekatatu rine mativi maviri akaenzana akaenzana muhukuru'. Sarudza mutsetse unonetsa kubvuma sembiri.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.hint.0: Pamutsetse wega wega, cherechedza kana unoshandisa 'zvakapiwa (pfungwa yokutanga)' kana 'zvinofanira kuratidzwa (mhedziso)'.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.hint.1: Paradzanisa zvinhu zvitatu zviri mumutsetse 3 kuva kana chimwe nechimwe chiri pfungwa yokutanga, chakawanikwa mumutsetse wapfuura, kana chaifanira kuratidzwa.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.1: Ngatiti M ipakati pedivi BC uye batanidza A ne M nechikamu. Wobva wava BM = CM.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.2: Mukatatu ABM nokatatu ACM, AB = AC, ∠B = ∠C (makona epasi ekatatu rine mativi maviri akaenzana), uye AM yakafanana.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.3: Saka katatu ABM nokatatu ACM zvakaenzana.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.4: Mumakatatu akaenzana makona anoenderana akaenzana muhukuru, saka ∠B = ∠C.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.explain: Mumutsetse 3, ∠B = ∠C yakatonyorwa sokunge ichokwadi. Iyo ndiyo mhedziso mbiri inofanira kuratidza. Nokudaro, kuenzana mumutsetse 4 kunewo hapana hwaro (AB, ∠B, AM hazvisi mativi maviri nekona iri pakati), uye mutsetse 5 unopedzisira wagumisa nokudzokorora zvakanyorwa pakutanga.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.prompt: Unoda kugadzirisa mbiri yaSeohyeon. Kana uchichinja nzira yokuratidza kuenzana mumutsetse 3, sarudza nzira dzose dzinoita kuti mbiri ive yakarurama.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.hint.0: Panzira yega yega, tarisa kana zvinhu zvitatu zvakashandiswa zvose ari pfungwa dzokutanga, kana zvinotevera zvakananga kubva panzira yakasarudzwa M.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa kana ine chimiro chinoenderana nemamiriro okufanana (SSS, SAS, RHS). Tarisawo kana sarudzo ipi neipi ichishandisa mhedziso ∠B = ∠C.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.a: Tora M sechigunwe chomutsetse wakananga kubva ku A kuenda ku BC uye uenzanise uchishandisa AB = AC, AM yakafanana, ∠AMB = ∠AMC = 90°
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.b: Nyora ∠B = ∠C uye uwedzere kuti izvi zvakarurama nokuti zvinoratidzika kudaro mumufananidzo
y-m-26-02.s.s2.r.b: Kuoneka kudaro mumufananidzo hakusi hwaro hwembiri. Mbiri inoratidza chikonzero chokuti sei zvinoratidzika kudaro.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.c: Tora M sepoinzi apo bisekita ye ∠A inosangana ne BC uye uenzanise uchishandisa AB = AC, ∠BAM = ∠CAM, AM yakafanana
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.d: Nyora kuti makatatu ABM ne ACM akaenzana nokuti nzvimbo dzawo dzakaenzana, wobva wanyora kuti makona anoenderana akaenzana
y-m-26-02.s.s2.r.d: Kunyange nzvimbo dzakaenzana, zvimiro zvinogona kusiyana (semuenzaniso, marekitengi ane upamhi nokukwira kwakasiyana). Nzvimbo dzakaenzana oga hadzienzanisi.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.e: Tora M sepakati pa BC uye uenzanise uchishandisa AB = AC, BM = CM, AM yakafanana
y-m-26-02.s.s2.explain: e yakaenzana nokuti mativi matatu akaenzana (SSS), c nokuti mativi maviri nekona iri pakati zvakaenzana (SAS), uye a nokuti hypotenuse nedivi rimwe rekatatu rine kona yakarurama zvakaenzana (RHS). Hapana nzira inonyora ∠B = ∠C pakutanga; dzinowana ∠B = ∠C kubva pakuenzana.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora meseji yokuudza Seohyeon. Taura kuti sei mbiri yekutanga isingagoni kutaurwa kuti yakaratidza 'makona epasi akaenzana', uye unyore nzira yokuigadzirisa nenzira imwe yepamusoro.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mumutsara mumwe kuti ndechipi pazvinhu zvitatu zvakanyorwa mumutsetse 3 chinofanira kuratidzwa.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.hint.1: Sarudza nzira yaunoda kubva pasarudzo dziri pamusoro, nyora zvinhu zvitatu zvainoshandisa, uye utarise kana zvichienderana nezita remamiriro okufanana.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mukunyora kwako, zvakajeka here 'chakatoshandiswa mumutsetse upi'?
y-m-26-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Munzira yawakagadzirisa nayo, unoshandisa ∠B = ∠C semhedziso chete here?
y-m-26-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Munzira yawakagadzirisa nayo, zvinhu zvitatu zvemamiriro okufanana zvose zvakapiwa here, kana zvinobva panzira yakasarudzwa M?
y-m-26-02.s.s3.model.0: Mutsetse 3 unotoshandisa ∠B = ∠C. Iyo mhedziso inofanira kuratidzwa, saka haifaniri kushandiswa sehwaro. Unogona kugadzirisa nokushandisa kuenzana kwe SSS nepfungwa yokutanga AB = AC, BM = CM inoonekwa nokuti M ipakati, uye AM yakafanana.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.model.1: Inounza ∠B = ∠C, inofanira kuratidzwa, sehwaro hwokuenzana pakutanga, saka mbiri inotenderera. Kana ukatora poinzi M uchishandisa bisekita ye ∠A uye ukashandisa kuenzana kwe SAS ne AB = AC, ∠BAM = ∠CAM, AM yakafanana, haufaniri kufungidzira ∠B = ∠C pakutanga.

y-m-26-05.title: Tinogona kugadzira matriangle enzvimbo 12 nenzira dzakawanda here?
y-m-26-05.goal: Nzwisisa kuti mamiriro ematriangle ane base imwe chete ane nzvimbo yakafanana ihurefu, uye uwane mapoinzi akawanda anoita mamiriro enzvimbo nehukuru hwekona panguva imwe chete, uchitsanangura chikonzero.
y-m-26-05.material: Pacoordinate plane, rega kureba kwesquare imwe kuve 1cm. Pane mapoinzi A(0, 0) ne B(6, 0), uye poinzi P iri pamusoro pe x-axis. Unotsvaga poinzi P yakadai kuti nzvimbo yetriangle ABP i12cm², uye macoordinate eP ari maintegers.
y-m-26-05.thinking.0: Kuwana mhinduro dzakawanda dzinoita mamiriro panguva imwe chete
y-m-26-05.prereq.0: Nzvimbo yetriangle = base × hurefu ÷ 2 (ukuru hwegiredhi 5 rechikoro chepuraimari)
y-m-26-05.prereq.1: Nzvimbo yemapoinzi pacoordinate plane, uye zvinoreva acute, right, ne obtuse angles
y-m-26-05.prereq.2: Kana mitsetse miviri iri parallel, daro pakati pavo rakagara (daro pakati pemitsetse yakafanana)
y-m-26-05.s.s1.prompt: Pacoordinate plane pane A(0, 0) ne B(6, 0). Unoda poinzi P iri pamusoro pe x-axis uye nzvimbo yetriangle ABP i12cm². Ungawana chimiro chipi kana ukaunganidza mapoinzi ose P akadaro? (Square imwe i1cm)
y-m-26-05.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira kuti hurefu hunofanira kuva hurefu sei kuti nzvimbo ive 12 kana uchiona AB sebase yetriangle ABP.
y-m-26-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kana ukafambisa P kumusoro nepazasi perpendicular neAB, fungidzira nzira dzaungafambira uchichengeta hurefu hwakafanana.
y-m-26-05.s.s1.o.a: Mapoinzi ari padenderedzwa padaro rakagara kubva kuA
y-m-26-05.s.s1.r.a: Kunyange kana mapoinzi ari padenderedzwa padaro rimwe chete kubva kuA, daro rawo kubva kuAB (hurefu) rinosiyana.
y-m-26-05.s.s1.o.b: Poinzi imwe chete. Kana nzvimbo yagadziriswa pa12, P yagadziriswa kuita imwe
y-m-26-05.s.s1.r.b: Kuva nebase imwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete kunoreva kuva nehurefu hwakafanana. Pane poinzi imwe chete here ine hurefu hwakafanana?
y-m-26-05.s.s1.o.c: Mapoinzi ari pamutsetse unopfuura nepakati peAB uye uri perpendicular neAB
y-m-26-05.s.s1.r.c: Mapoinzi ari pamutsetse uyu ane marefu akasiyana kubva kuAB, saka hurefu hunosiyana. Nzvimbo dzinova dzakasiyana.
y-m-26-05.s.s1.o.d: Mapoinzi ari pamutsetse une parallel neAB uye uri 4cm kubva kuAB
y-m-26-05.s.s1.explain: Base AB = 6cm yakafanana, saka kuti nzvimbo ive 12cm², hurefu hunofanira kuva 12 × 2 ÷ 6 = 4cm. Mapoinzi ari pahurefu 4cm kubva kuAB ndiwo mapoinzi ose ari pamutsetse une parallel neAB (y = 4).
y-m-26-05.s.s2.prompt: Wana mapoinzi 3 akasiyana P akadai kuti nzvimbo yetriangle ABP i12cm² uye makona ese matatu ari acute (makona madiki kupfuura 90°). Macoordinate eP ari maintegers.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.hint.0: Pakati pemapoinzi ari pamutsetse wawakawana nhanho yapfuura, chinja x-coordinate imwe panguva uye uongorore kana makona ari acute.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.hint.1: Dhirowa zvinoitika kumakona epamapoinzi A neB kana x-coordinate iri diki zvakanyanya kana hurusa.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.ok.c1: P ipoinzi ine macoordinate maintegers iri pamusoro pe x-axis.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.fail.c1: P inofanira kuva pamusoro pe x-axis (y>0) uye ine macoordinate maintegers.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Nzvimbo yetriangle ABP haisi 12cm². Ongorora zvakare base AB nehurefu.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Rimwe remakona matatu irakarurama kana obtuse. Ongorora makona epamapoinzi A, B, ne P rimwe nerimwe.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.explain: Kana P iri (1, 4), (2, 4), (3, 4), (4, 4), (5, 4), dzose dzine hurefu 4cm saka nzvimbo i12. Kana x-coordinate iri 0 kana 6, pane kona yakarurama paA kana paB, uye kunze kwaizvozvo i obtuse. Saka mapoinzi aya mashanu ndiwo chete maintegers. Poinzi (3, 4) inopa isosceles triangle, uye mamwe matriangle ane michimiro yakasiyana.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Enzanisa mapoinzi awakawana. Tsanangura kuti nei nzvimbo dzakafanana kunyange chimiro chetriangle chakasiyana nepoinzi imwe neimwe, uye kuti mamiriro eacute-angle akaganhura sei nzvimbo dzemapoinzi.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Enzanisa ma y-coordinate emapoinzi awakawana uye utaure kuti ari pamutsetse upi.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Dhirowa makona epamapoinzi A neB ari madhigirii mangani kana x-coordinate yeP iri 0 uye kana iri 6.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura kuti nei nzvimbo dzakafanana se 'base yakafanana uye hurefu hwakafanana futi' here?
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura nemakona kuti nei hazvishandi kana x-coordinate iri 0, 6, kana kunze here?
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Mapoinzi ari pamutsetse une parallel neAB, saka kuona AB sebase, hurefu hwose hwakafanana 4, uye base yakafanana 6, saka nzvimbo dzose i12. Kana x-coordinate iri 0 kana 6, pane kona yakarurama paA kana paB, uye kana iri pasi pe0 kana kupfuura 6 i obtuse, saka 1 kusvika 5 chete dzinoshanda.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Base AB i6 uye hurefu hwakafanana 4, saka kunyange michimiro ichisiyana nzvimbo dzakafanana. Makona anofanira kuva acute, saka P haifanire kuva pakarepo pamusoro peA kana B kana kunze kwadzo, uye x-coordinate inofanira kuva pakati pe0 ne6.
